claims.claim: The no-argument diagnostic and dedicated pytest observer run one collection and at most one full-n12 execution, followed only when failures exist by one serial and one n4 replay of the exact raw failure set.

The observer retains failures up to the 64-identity bound. The diagnostic validates test paths separately from parameter data, rejects malformed or inconsistent observations and fingerprints, and reports deterministic safe identities without raw parameter values.
The diagnostic enforces subject stability, collection and execution identity, distinct processes, and isolated pytest and Git fixture roots across phases.
The final observation exposes safe identities for full-n12 failures and their serial and n4 reproduction subsets, with only the specified mechanical classifications.

Regression tests cover the specified outcomes and integrity failures, plus exact replay and safe reporting for parameter data containing paths, quotes, URLs, double dots, and other formerly rejected characters.
